# Daily invariant verification job

> A daily job that confirms the entire ledger and recent journals sum to zero, catching imbalances that bypassed commit-time checks.

_Part of [Ledger partitions and invariant checks](ledger-maintenance.md)_

All bookkeeping entries live in the [`LedgerEntry`](recording-money-in-ledger.md) table. Each journal (a set of entries) must sum to exactly zero by design—debits equal credits. At commit time, a trigger enforces this. But manual changes or a disabled trigger could let an imbalance slip through. The `ledger.verify-invariants` job runs daily at 02:15 UTC to catch these gaps. It queries the sum of all `LedgerEntry.amount` values (should be 0), then scans journals from the last 2 days to find any where the lines don't balance. If it finds violations, it increments an OpenTelemetry counter (`ledger_invariant_violations_total`), logs the unbalanced journal IDs, and pages an on-call engineer (O-01). It doesn't fix the imbalance—it's a safety net on top of commit-time checks.

**Look at:** [ledger-maintenance.jobs.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/ledger-maintenance.jobs.ts)

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | [`LedgerEntry`](recording-money-in-ledger.md) | Read entire table to sum amounts (should total 0) and recent entries (last 2 days) grouped by `journalId` to find any unbalanced journals |
| other | `ledger_invariant_violations_total` | OpenTelemetry counter incremented when violations are found (by 1 + the count of unbalanced journals) |
| job | `ledger.verify-invariants` | Scheduled daily at 02:15 UTC via [`JobsService`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/infrastructure/jobs/jobs.service.ts#L14), runs with concurrency 1 and a 5-minute lease to prevent overlapping executions |

## Watch out

- Only checks journals from the last 2 days, not historical ones. Older imbalances won't be caught.
- The job logs and alerts but doesn't auto-fix. Someone has to investigate the flagged journals and manually correct the ledger.
- Runs at 02:15 UTC daily. If you're debugging ledger issues, expect to see this in the logs around that time.
- The 5-minute lease prevents concurrent runs. A slow check can delay the next scheduled run.
